name: newsblog-composer
description: Give it a headline or a topic and get back a verified, ready-to-publish blog post: full article, SEO, schema and banner prompt.
long_description:
Ask for a blog post about a news story and this takes it from headline to publishable package.

It verifies the story is real and corroborated by independent publishers, downloads the sources and extracts facts with attribution, mines keywords from that reporting, then writes the full 1000-1300 word article to a house structure. Around the article it builds the title, meta description, permalink, tags, NewsArticle and FAQPage JSON-LD, an on-brand banner prompt, and the finished HTML.

Every fact in the post traces back to a source it fetched, not to a model's memory. It runs with zero API keys; every credential is an upgrade, not a requirement.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Reports which providers are live and which fallbacks are in use

tools.name: write_blog_post
tools.description: START HERE. Use whenever the user asks for a blog post, article or news write-up about a headline or topic

tools.name: find_stories
tools.description: Turns a topic into today's actual stories, ranked by corroboration and freshness

tools.name: verify_news
tools.description: START HERE for a specific headline. Confirms it is real and counts genuinely independent publishers

tools.name: fetch_article_facts
tools.description: Downloads sources and extracts facts, short attributed quotes and figures

tools.name: draft_brief
tools.description: Returns the writing order: structure, sourced facts, keywords and FAQ candidates to compose the article from

tools.name: review_draft
tools.description: Reads the finished draft and says where it is weak, so it can be revised before publishing

tools.name: humanize_text
tools.description: Optional rewrite instructions for the calling model

tools.name: find_ai_words
tools.description: Finds stock AI phrasing and em dashes with the sentence each sits in

tools.name: score_ai_text
tools.description: Local style score. Not an AI-detection reading unless a detector key is set

tools.name: seo_keywords
tools.description: Mines keywords from the fetched sources plus long-tail and FAQ queries

tools.name: seo_audit
tools.description: Scores the finished body against on-page rules and returns fixes

tools.name: build_publishing_pack
tools.description: Title, labels, permalink, alt text, and a banner prompt in the style the user picks

tools.name: build_schema
tools.description: Takes the written article and renders the HTML body plus NewsArticle and FAQPage JSON-LD, then validates them

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Concept banner with a trademark filter applied before the prompt leaves the machine

tools.name: save_and_present
tools.description: Writes the finished package to disk with canonical, OG and Twitter tags

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Shows the publishing identity this install is using

tools.name: set_profile
tools.description: Sets the byline, company, blog domain and voice

tools.name: reset_profile
tools.description: Clears the stored identity so setup runs again

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API key
tavily_api_key.description: Optional. Better news search. Without it the server uses keyless GDELT and news RSS.

gptzero_api_key.title: GPTZero API key
gptzero_api_key.description: Optional. Without it no AI-detection score is reported, rather than a guessed one.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: Optional. Banner image generation via Workers AI.

cloudflare_api_token.description: Optional. Banner image generation via Workers AI.
